items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 95:1
items.html: For the matter of the sin of Adam HaRishon was that he coupled and drew down the Mochin that were fit to come to him on the day of Sabbath, which are the aspect of the ultimate greatness (as the ARI writes, item 678, item 87), which Mochin extend down to the point of this world, level with the feet of Adam Kadmon. For this is the secret of ‘they ate unripe fruit,’ meaning before its time. For had he waited with that coupling until the day of Sabbath, those Mochin would have come as they properly should, and he would not have flawed them; but since he performed that coupling before its time, not only did he fail to correct anything, he further flawed them and cast them down to the Klipot, as is known. And ‘eating’ is the secret of coupling, from the verse, ‘she eats and wipes her mouth.’ And you see that this is entirely similar to the breaking of the vessels, for there too the Mochin of ZAT came out and extended down to the point of this world, and they too died and fell to the Klipot, as is known. (Inner Light, Item 687, Sub Header, “And Know”)
